phase1_inventory.source_ref: Main text, Eqs. (4) and entropy-evaluation derivation ending at Eq. (entronu)
phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: For an L-spin block in the XY ground state, the reduced state factorizes into independent fermionic modes and its entanglement entropy is S_L=Σ_m H_2((1+ν_m)/2).
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Correlation-matrix-to-entropy computation for block entanglement in the XY chain.

phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: For the critical XX model with magnetic field, the block entropy scales as S_L^{XX}≈(1/3)log_2L+k_1(a).
For the critical Ising chain (γ=1,a=1), the block entropy scales as S_L^{Ising}≈(1/6)log_2L+k_2 with k_2≈π/3.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Critical Ising-chain entropy scaling law and reported offset.

phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: Near the Ising critical point, the half-chain entropy obeys S_{N/2}^{Ising}≈(1/6)log_2(1/|1-a|).
For 1D critical spin chains, the entanglement entropy diverges as S_L≈((c+\bar c)/6)log_2L+k, with coefficient fixed by the conformal central charges.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Universal CFT scaling law for critical block entanglement.

phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: The critical Ising chain has c=\bar c=1/2, whereas the critical XX and XXZ regimes discussed in the paper have c=\bar c=1, so the XX entropy-growth coefficient is twice the Ising coefficient.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Central-charge assignments and their predicted ratio of entropy-growth slopes.

phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: At a=1, the asymptotic entropy offset between anisotropy values satisfies lim_{L→∞}[S_L(γ=1)−S_L(γ)]=−((c+\bar c)/6)log_2γ.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Subleading anisotropy-dependent correction for critical XY entropies.

phase1_inventory.source_ref: Main text, Fig. 1 and surrounding non-critical-regime discussion
phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: Away from criticality, the Ising-chain block entropy saturates to a finite value with a finite entanglement length that diverges only at the critical point a=1.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Non-critical Ising entropy surface S_L(L,a) and its saturation behavior.

phase1_inventory.source_ref: Main text, Fig. 2 and its caption
phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: Numerical data for the critical Ising, XX, and finite-size XXX chains agree with the logarithmic CFT scaling lines, with the XX incremental entropy approximately twice the Ising incremental entropy.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Critical-entropy comparison plot across Ising, XX, and XXX chains.

phase1_inventory.source_ref: Main text, c-theorem discussion after Fig. 2
phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: Because the coefficient of critical entanglement is the central charge, Zamolodchikov's c-theorem implies that ground-state entanglement decreases along renormalization-group flows.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: RG monotonicity interpretation derived from the critical-entropy coefficient.

phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: For the infinite XY chain, the spectrum of reduced density matrices satisfies the majorization relation λ⃗_{L+2}≺λ⃗_L for all L.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Majorization ordering of block reduced-state spectra as block size increases.
